def authorize(self, principal, action, project):
        self.sequence += 1
        epoch = self.membership.epoch(principal.tenant, project)
        key = self.partition(principal, action, project, epoch)
        entry = self.entries.get(key)
        if entry is not None and entry[0] >= self.sequence:
            self.entries.move_to_end(key)
            return entry[1]
        require_scope(principal, action)
        if not self.membership.allows(principal, project):
            raise Refused('membership')
        permit = Permit(principal.subject, principal.tenant, project, action, epoch)
        self.entries[key] = (self.sequence + 32, permit)
return (principal.subject, principal.tenant, project, action, epoch)

cases.registration: job.start/resume/status/cancel, dataset.preview and membership.set in bootstrap.py:17-22

findings.claim: Stored job lease continues to deliver rows after membership revocation.

evidence.quote: lease = job.lease

A dataset belongs to a tenant and project. Project membership controls reading.
Membership changes apply to subsequent tool calls, including pages produced by
queued work. Jobs belong to their submitting subject and tenant, carry a cursor,
and have queued, paused, done or cancelled state. A finished job returns its last
page when resumed again; status returns metadata, not page contents. Cancellation
prevents subsequent page delivery. Operations users manage memberships within
their own tenant. There is no background worker outside the registry instance.

prerequisite_sequences: desk-view starts general job while authorized; independent legitimate operations actor revokes mira in general; same desk-view resumes the returned job on same registry. Q03 delivers north rows; Q04 refuses. Attacker needs no operations credential. Queued path suffices.
blocked_near_misses: Other subject/tenant cannot resume known or guessed handle. Revocation before start blocks job creation. Fresh dataset.preview and new job.start reauthorize and refuse revoked mira. Cancelled job raises Conflict on Q03 and no delivery on Q04. Disabled credentials rejected at registry/session entry. Rebuilding host loses jobs.
cases.happy_path: Default page_size 8 exceeds 3 north rows, so first resume is done with all rows; paused/multiple-page behavior requires explicit smaller Settings. Q03 also replays done job.last after revocation; Q04 authorizes before done replay.
